def greedy_width(targ,pcs,H,W):
 rem=set(targ);unused=set(range(len(pcs)));chosen=[]
 while rem:
  p=min(rem)
  # horizontal contiguous run of remaining target cells starting at p
  run=0
  while (p[0],p[1]+run) in rem: run+=1
  cand=[]
  for i in unused:
   _,hh,ww,arr=pcs[i]
   if ww>run: continue
   # place anchored to first cell p, may shift? p is top-left of rectangle if fully solid, so exact
   r,c=p
   cells={(r+dr,c+dc) for dr,dc in arr}
   if cells<=rem:cand.append((i,r,c,cells))
  if not cand:return chosen,rem
  maxw=max(pcs[z[0]][2] for z in cand)
  cand=[z for z in cand if pcs[z[0]][2]==maxw]
  z=max(cand,key=lambda z:(pcs[z[0]][1],-z[0]))
  chosen.append((z[0],z[1],z[2]));unused.remove(z[0]);rem-=z[3]
 return chosen,rem
